author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Google dismantled a 1.3 million-device botnet allegedly built by Android TV box maker Videostrong to enable ad fraud and proxy abuse. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: NIS2 Article 20 makes management bodies answerable for the access controls they approve, and boards are starting to ask for proof that those controls work. title: NIS2 Makes Board Members Personally Liable for Access Control Decisions
